label: Continue, then complete
description: Two rounds: the first classifies continue and loops followup; the second classifies complete and the loop stops.
scenario: A representative Backlog Follow-up run over one backlog item that needs two rounds to finish.

handoff.summary: Round 1 of Backlog Follow-up advanced the work; more remains.

steps.note: handoff.progress=continue L1-derives at the edge → loops followup

handoff.summary: Round 2 of Backlog Follow-up finished the unit of work.
handoff.next_step: Hand off to the next stage.

steps.note: handoff.progress=complete L1-derives at the edge → guarded stop
